extDescription.message: Keep your AWS sign-in URLs and switch roles in one list and open them in one click. Unofficial; not affiliated with AWS.

typeLoginHint.message: Opens the AWS sign-in page and fills in the account, user name and password.

typeSwitchRoleHint.message: Switches to a role in another account. Sign in to the AWS console first.

popupSearchPlaceholder.message: Search by name, account ID or role

popupEmptyBody.message: Add an AWS account and it shows up here, ready to open in one click.

popupNoMatchBody.message: Try a display name, an account ID or a role name.

popupNoLoginBody.message: Add an account's sign-in URL to open it from here.

popupNoSwitchRoleBody.message: Add an account ID and role name to switch roles from here.

unlockBody.message: Saved passwords are locked. Unlock to fill or copy them.

toastBadUrl.message: This environment's URL isn't an https:// address. Fix it in Manage environments.

toastOpenFailed.message: Couldn't open the environment. Try again.

toastFilled.message: Filled in your sign-in details. Check them and sign in.

toastFilledPartly.message: Filled in some fields. Enter the rest yourself.

toastFillFailed.message: Couldn't find the sign-in fields. Enter your details yourself.

toastSwitchFailed.message: Couldn't find the Switch Role button. Press it yourself.

toastMasterSet.message: Master password set. Saved passwords are now protected by it.

toastVaultReset.message: Removed $1 saved password(s). Set things up again in Settings.

toastImportedPlain.message: Imported $1 environment(s). This file holds unencrypted passwords — delete it when you no longer need it.

optionsReorderHint.message: Drag rows, or use the arrow buttons, to change the order. The popup uses the same order.

optionsEmptyBody.message: Register an AWS account's sign-in page or a role to switch to. You can also import a backup from another browser.

fieldAccountIdHint.message: 12 digits or an account alias. Hyphens are removed.

fieldLabelHint.message: Up to 8 characters, shown on the color tab.

fieldLoginUrlHint.message: Leave empty to use the URL made from the account ID.

passwordSavedHint.message: A password is saved. Type a new one only to replace it.

loginFillNote.message: Open fills in the sign-in form. It never presses Sign in or enters MFA codes for you.

switchRoleNote.message: Switching roles works after you have signed in to the AWS Management Console.

fieldFilePasswordHint.message: Needed when you import this file. It can be the same as your master password.

errorAccountInvalid.message: Enter a 12-digit account ID or an account alias (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens).

errorUrlInvalid.message: Enter a URL that starts with https://.

errorWrongFilePassword.message: That isn't the password for this file.

errorImportFormat.message: Couldn't read the file. Choose a backup exported from this extension.

errorImportEmpty.message: The file has no environments that can be imported.

securityIntro.message: Saved passwords are always encrypted. Choose who holds the key.

securityDevice.message: Encrypted with a key on this device

securityDeviceHelp.message: The extension made a key and keeps it on this device, so there's nothing to type. Anyone who can use this browser profile can still open your environments. If others use this computer, set a master password.

securityMasterHelp.message: The key is made from your master password and is never stored. Saved passwords stay locked until you unlock them, and lock again when the browser closes or after the time below.

setMasterBody.message: You'll enter it to fill or copy saved passwords after the extension locks.

masterPasswordWarning.message: If you forget it, saved passwords can't be recovered. Other details stay.

removeMasterBody.message: Saved passwords will be encrypted with a key kept on this device instead. You won't be asked to unlock them anymore.

forgotBody.message: Saved passwords can't be recovered without it. You can remove only the saved passwords and keep everything else, then set protection up again.

forgotConfirmBody.message: All saved passwords will be removed. Display names, account IDs, user names and roles stay. This can't be undone.

backupIntro.message: Move your environments to another browser or computer.

backupHelp.message: Importing always adds to what's here; nothing is overwritten.

exportBody.message: Saves your environments to a JSON file. Import it in another browser to move them.

exportIncludeText.message: Passwords are encrypted with a password for this file.

exportExcludeText.message: Everything else is exported. Re-enter passwords after importing.

importPasswordBody.message: This backup's passwords are protected. Enter the password chosen when it was exported.

storageBody1.message: Everything stays in this browser profile on this device. It isn't synced to your Google account and is never sent anywhere.

storageBody2.message: Uninstalling the extension deletes your data. Export a backup first if you want to keep it.

aboutLead.message: Account Deck for AWS keeps your AWS sign-in pages and switch roles in one list, so you can open the right account without mixing up production and development.

aboutDisclaimer.message: Account Deck for AWS is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Amazon Web Services, Inc. AWS and Amazon Web Services are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.

welcomeTitle.message: Welcome to Account Deck for AWS

welcomeLead.message: Register your AWS sign-in pages and roles, then open them from the toolbar.

welcomeProtectTitle.message: How should saved passwords be protected?

welcomeMasterText.message: Passwords are encrypted with a key made from a password only you know. You enter it after the browser restarts or the extension locks.

welcomeDeviceText.message: Passwords are encrypted with a key kept on this device. Nothing to type, but anyone using this browser profile can use them. You can set a master password later.

welcomeFirstBody.message: Add a sign-in page or a role now, or import a backup from another browser.
